dct_description_sm: Abstract: This datalayer contains boundary polylines for significant erosion hazard areas for the western half of King County, Washington.

Purpose: The erosion hazards layer (ERODE) is a working (maintenance) copy of the Sensitive Areas Ordinance GIS data set ERODESAO. As of October, 1997, the content of the two coverages is the same. ERODESAO is suitable for general reference, medium to small scale map displays, and generalized analyses.
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: For educational non-commercial use only. This data may not be redistributed by HGL users. King County data are made available with the understanding that they shall be used exclusively by the obtainer or his/her authorized agents.
Access constraints: Access is granted to Harvard University Affiliates only. Affiliates are limited to current faculty, staff and students.
